title: Bulk load (INSERT BULK) from tedious/mssql
summary: Part of #710 (task `gaps-bulk-v1`, depends on the extension hooks in #711). - INSERT BULK table (columns) [WITH (options)] followed by a BulkLoadBCP message loads rows with SQL Server types, constraints, identity handling (KEEP_IDENTITY), CHECK_CONSTRAINTS, FIRE_TRIGGERS and KEEP_NULLS options and returns SQL Server's row count, using the existing bulk-load codec read-only. - mssql Table with request.bulk() and tedious newBulkLoad succeed for integer, string, Unicode, decimal, datetime, datetimeoffset, binary, bit and NULL values; tests assert loaded rows.
